Nadia, I posted the list in your thread in #strategic-pod. It has five Vantorre Group tickets, each with its source:

1. **#8841**: Pemberline Dock kiosk/carrier portal. Sources: #strategic-pod (Jul 1, Gideon says it was closed with support); Moss digest 5/4 (still open, Allentown Door 12); Moss digest 9/30 (Mateo submitted it for Newark Door 14 and it was escalated). The sources disagree on status and site, so please check the ticketing system.
2. **#PD-8841**: missed carrier check-ins at Allentown Gate 4. Source: Moss digest 4/27. It may be the same issue as #8841, but the digest doesn't say.
3. **#PD-4418**: Carrier_Dwell_Summary export dropping timestamps at Dock Door 9. Source: Moss digest 9/15. That digest doesn't name the account.
4. **INC-4821**: Hartford gate kiosks offline on Aug 3, plus a separate status-page access problem. Source: #inc-vtg-hartford.
5. **VT-55120**: root cause of the Hartford kiosk outage. Source: #inc-vtg-hartford, Oct 14.

Moss's Aug 3 digest covers the Hartford incident but gives no ticket number. I left out Vantorre Mobility's tickets and Quillfeather's PD-4402.
